rationale: The interpreter introduced an unsupported assumption by adding a rule to always exclude entries with isActive=false, which is not specified in the ticket. Additionally, the interpreter correctly identified three genuine ambiguities present in the ticket that remain unresolved. These open ambiguities block a PASS result.

findings.description: The interpreter adds a rule to always exclude entries with isActive=false, which is not required by the ticket.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported exclusion rule from the business rules.

findings.description: The ticket does not define how the Condenser Type maps to Unit Type; the example data only contains refrigerant parents.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the Condenser Type mapping for Unit Type filtering.

sourceRefs.quote: The Condenser Type mapping is unclear because the example parent data contains refrigerants.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify the behavior when a filter yields no results.
findings.action: Clarify the expected UI/UX behavior when filtering returns an empty set.

findings.description: The ticket does not define case sensitivity rules or how downstream selections should be reset after a change.
findings.action: Clarify case‑sensitivity handling and downstream selection reset behavior.

sourceRefs.quote: Case sensitivity and downstream selection reset behavior are unspecified.
